Game Overview

In Border Battleground, the core idea is straightforward: engage in intense border conflict as a skilled soldier in Border Battleground. Utilize stealth and strategic prowess in a snowy, atmospheric war zone, where every decision impacts your mission. Gather weapons, avoid detection, and complete challenging objectives to prevent looming chaos, all from a gripping first-person perspective.
